mechanism: Propylthiouracil may inhibit hepatic metabolism of nortriptyline via CYP450 enzymes, potentially increasing tricyclic antidepressant levels and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for nortriptyline toxicity signs (tremor, tachycardia, confusion); consider ECG monitoring and possible dose reduction of nortriptyline if hypothyroidism develops or PTU dosing changes.
